name: Particle Filter Expansion Inventory
description: Declarative refinement inventory for particle filter pipelines.

operations.name: Insert Effective Sample Size Monitoring
operations.dejargonized_summary: Monitor whether particle weights have collapsed after reweighting.

rewrite.before_summary: Reweighted particles flow downstream without degeneracy evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: An effective-sample-size monitor is inserted after reweighting.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds particle degeneracy evidence before resampling or estimation.

operations.name: Insert Particle Diversity Analysis
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether predicted particles still cover enough state diversity.

rewrite.before_summary: Predicted particles flow onward without diversity evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A particle-diversity analyzer is inserted after prediction.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds state-space coverage evidence for the particle set.

operations.name: Insert Weight Variance Tracking
operations.dejargonized_summary: Track whether final particle weights are too concentrated.

rewrite.before_summary: Postprocessed particles flow downstream without weight trend evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A weight-variance tracker is inserted after postprocessing.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds weight concentration evidence before final particle summaries.

operations.name: Insert Resampling Quality Check
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether resampling preserves enough particle diversity.

rewrite.before_summary: Preprocessed particles flow toward resampling without duplication evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A resampling quality check is inserted after preprocessing.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds diversity-preservation evidence for resampling decisions.

audit.rationale: Moves existing particle filter expansion rules onto the common provider expansion schema.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Reusable checks for particle degeneracy, diversity, weight variance, and resampling quality.
